market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy. Bond yields at 20-year highs create headwind for equities; oil above $103 sustains inflation pressure. Nasdaq/Dow divergence suggests rotation from banks to tech. M&A activity (Royal Caribbean/Sandals, Paramount/Warner) provides idiosyncratic upside. Fed hawkishness and USD strength cap risk appetite. Expect 2-4% volatility in major indices over next 4-6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle and semiconductor demand support tech leadership through 2027. Bond market normalization will pressure rate-sensitive sectors (housing, REITs) but benefit financials. Geopolitical fragmentation (EU-China, Iran legacy) creates structural tailwinds for energy and defense. Crypto maturation and AI security represent new growth vectors. Key risk: if inflation persists, Fed may force a broader correction in 2027 H1.
